what.text: This page follows refugees from Eritrea living in Switzerland, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 38539 Eritrean refugees in Switzerland, 6.9% of all refugees from Eritrea.
Ethiopia and Sudan host the most Eritrean refugees, followed by Germany and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Eritrea and Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000, reaching war level, and again in 2016.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Eritrea in 1997, 1999 and 2003, with EIJM - AS as the opposition group in 1999 and 2003.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1998 at 15 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 38588, at the end of 2021, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Switzerland.
These are year-end totals for Switzerland only, reported to UNHCR.
